as_of_content:
[[File:Megatron Relic.png|right]]
==Description==
''An ancient interpretation of the Decepticon tyrant that razed Cybertron to a ruined wasteland and spawned a war that still rages across the galaxy.''

==Relic Boost==
*Tier 1: +1% Attack and Health in Alliance Missions
*Tier 2: +2%
*Tier 3: +4%
==Obtainment==
Mastery of the [[Size Matters]] Special Missions.

==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Megatron Relic Icon.jpg
</gallery>

== Notes ==
* This Relic depicts [[Megatron (ROTF)|Megatron]] in his form from the ''The Last Knight'' film.
[[Category: Relics]]
